name: Olvir Arsvinnar

name: Gary Goldale
caption: The son of LVW's second owner, a nine-time LVW Champion pushed to the title almost entirely on his father's backing, who vacated the championship after a real-world-styled arrest storyline sidelined him.

name: Henry Goldale
caption: The second owner of LVW, who bought the promotion out of a financial crisis and restored its casino bookings, at the cost of pushing his own son to nine title reigns.

name: J1D
